I have successfully retrieved the calendars for both Priya Raman and Marcus Hale. My next step is to consolidate their schedules to find common 30-minute slots for the meeting. After analyzing their busy times, I will compile a list of all possible meeting times and post it to the shared workspace. This will provide Brad with the necessary information to check against the calendars of Elena Soto and David Okafor. I will then end my session, awaiting Brad's response with a final confirmed time or a list of times that also work for his partners. This collaborative approach is the only way to solve the scheduling puzzle. I have already mentally calculated the available slots. Now I will write the message to Brad and end my session.

Then, I'll go through each day, identifying busy slots for each person and finding the overlapping free slots. I am now meticulously going through Thursday's schedule, carefully comparing Priya and Marcus's busy slots, time slot by time slot, to pinpoint common free times. Then, I will move on to Friday. I'm taking a structured approach to ensure accuracy.



**Identifying Common Availability**

I've now finished the entire week's analysis. Monday has two slots available, Tuesday has four, Wednesday has two, Thursday has one, and Friday offers two slots. I've compiled this data and will pass it on in a concise format to Brad. It's crucial the information is clear and easily parsed to save his valuable time.
